crossRefs.note: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this…
Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from…
For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their…
He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I…
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
translations.bsb: And he said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why did you not come to me? Am I really not able to reward you richly?”
translations.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
translations.asv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honor?
